name: Keeping Promises
overview: Scripture reveals that God’s promises are unchanging and unfailing, as He does not lie or repent, and all He has spoken comes to pass (Numbers 23:19; Joshua 21:45; Joshua 23:14). Believers are called to reflect God's faithfulness by honoring their vows and not breaking their word, recognizing that failing to keep promises made to the Lord is considered sin (Numbers 30:2; Deuteronomy 23:21). God's covenant remains steadfast and unaltered, underscoring the seriousness with which promises should be regarded (Psalms 89:34).
